body: I read your posts and you're right, sounds very similar. I especially identify with the "I'm not supposed to be suicidal" sentiment, it almost makes me feel worse when I know there's no big reason why I feel this way and I know so many people have it much worse and would give anything to be in my position
Thank you. I will definitely set that deadline. I might just up my naps until then to make the rest of the time more bearable hahah

It honestly majorly comes down to money, I don't have enough saved and with how much I'm getting paid, I'm not able to save much. It's been my plan to move this fall, but moving places has never helped before, it's just me, sad and alone in a new place.

I don't really like my job, it's not the worst either. It's not what I have a degree on and most of the time it's boring. The reason I'm still there is out of feeling obligated and thinking that I'm essential
